resource_group_name.title: Resource Group Name
resource_group_name.description: The name of the resource group in which to create the Public IP Prefix.

ip_version.title: Ip Version
ip_version.description: (Optional) The IP Version to use, `IPv6` or `IPv4`. Changing this forces a new resource to be created. Default is `IPv4`.

lock.title: Lock
lock.description: Controls the Resource Lock configuration for this resource. The following properties can be specified:  - `kind` - (Required) The type of lock. Possible values are `\"CanNotDelete\"` and `\"ReadOnly\"`. - `name` - (Optional) The name of the lock. If not specified, a name will be generated based on the `kind` value. Changing this forces the creation of a new resource.

sku_tier.title: Sku Tier
sku_tier.description: (Optional) The SKU Tier that should be used for the Public IP. Possible values are `Regional` and `Global`. Defaults to `Regional`. Changing this forces a new resource to be created.

zones.title: Zones
zones.description: (Optional) The availability zones in which the Public IP Prefix should be deployed. Changing this forces a new resource to be created.

location.title: Location
location.description: Azure region where the Public IP Prefix should be deployed.

prefix_length.title: Prefix Length
prefix_length.description: (Optional) Specifies the number of bits of the prefix. The value can be set between 0 (4,294,967,296 addresses) and 31 (2 addresses). Defaults to `28`(16 addresses). Changing this forces a new resource to be created.

enable_telemetry.title: Enable Telemetry
enable_telemetry.description: This variable controls whether or not telemetry is enabled for the module. For more information see <https://aka.ms/avm/telemetryinfo>. If it is set to false, then no telemetry will be collected.

sku_name.title: Sku Name
sku_name.description: The SKU of the Public IP Prefix. Possible values are Standard and Basic.

name.title: Name
name.description: The name of the public IP Prefix.
